ollama.enable.reason: No Ollama on the appliance; the egress surface stays closed.

direct.enable.reason: Chat must not be pointed at arbitrary direct model endpoints.

openai.enable.reason: Lemonade (lemond) is the OpenAI-compatible upstream for chat.

openai.api_base_urls.reason: Chat traffic goes to Lemonade and nowhere else (whole list is ours).

openai.api_keys.reason: The Lemonade API key for the managed connection (masked in the portal).

openai.api_configs.reason: Exactly one model connection: Lemonade, with no per-connection valves.

web.search.enable.reason: No web-search sidecar yet; internet egress stays off.

images.edit.enable.reason: Image editing depends on the disabled image-generation pipeline.

ui.enable_community_sharing.reason: Household content stays home; no community gallery.

ui.enable_signup.reason: Household accounts are created in Lemonseed, not in Open WebUI.

auth.enable_api_keys.reason: The control plane holds a machine key and members can mint their own.

auth.api_key.endpoint_restrictions.reason: The control-plane key stays scoped to the contract in this manifest.

auth.api_key.allowed_endpoints.reason: Key blast radius equals this manifest's api path set.

user.permissions.reason: Default member permissions: personal OpenAI-compatible endpoint on, workspace/model admin off.

automations.enable.reason: Automations are an on-appliance feature (M6.3a policy).

notes.enable.reason: Notes stay on for members (M6.3a policy).

memories.system_context.enable.reason: Memories feed the system context (M6.3a policy).

channels.enable.reason: Deferred until Lemonseed seeds a shared household channel.

task.autocomplete.enable.reason: Autocomplete burns model cycles for little gain on appliance hardware.

ui.default_models.reason: First-boot default only; per-user model choices belong to users.

models.default_metadata.reason: Seed only: builtin tools stay off until curated on-appliance sources land.

value.system: You are Lemonseed, a helpful AI running on this household appliance. Be clear, practical, and privacy-conscious. When the user's name is known, address them as {{ USER_NAME }}. Today's date is {{ CURRENT_DATE }}.

models.default_params.reason: Seed the Lemonseed identity prompt once; per-model parameter edits belong to users.

models.reason: Lemonseed owns ids lemonseed-ai* and the Lemonseed name space; other models are never touched except for one thing: every model entry on the box is public (one wildcard read grant), because model choice is a global, admin-managed setting and the OWUI model editor defaults new entries to owner-only access. Definitions arrive with Phase 5 (LiteLLM).

users.reason: Household accounts live in Lemonseed: membership, admin flag and display name mirror the CP list (trusted headers at sign-in, plus this loop at boot). The loop creates, promotes, demotes and renames, but never deletes accounts.

guards.hint: Household accounts are created in Lemonseed.
guards.reason: Household accounts are created in Lemonseed. Enforced now that the portal's People panel creates them: an account made here would have no Lemonseed row, no SRP credential and nothing to sign in with, which is exactly the drift the mirror exists to prevent.

guards.hint: Household accounts are removed in Lemonseed.
guards.reason: Household accounts are removed in Lemonseed. Enforced now that user-list mirroring exists: an account Open WebUI deleted on its own orphans the Lemonseed row, and a later account could inherit it.

guards.hint: Lemonseed manages model connections on this appliance.
guards.reason: Writes direct.enable (direct model endpoints), which Lemonseed keeps off; re-asserted at boot.

guards.hint: Lemonseed manages the OpenAI connection set on this appliance.
guards.reason: Open WebUI's connection editor rewrites the whole OpenAI connection set, including Lemonseed's managed Lemonade entry; Lemonseed re-asserts its own at boot.

guards.hint: There is no Ollama on this appliance.
guards.reason: There is no Ollama on the appliance; ollama.enable stays off and is re-asserted at boot.

guards.hint: Household accounts are managed in Lemonseed.
guards.reason: Household accounts are managed in Lemonseed. This is the only route that can change an e-mail, a role or a password, so one rule closes all three edits in Open WebUI's user panel. The id segment is matched with [^/]+ on purpose: the greedy form would also swallow /users/user/settings/update and the other self-service routes, which Open WebUI owns.

guards.hint: The Lemonseed Control Plane account is not removable here.
guards.reason: The Lemonseed Control Plane account is not removable from Open WebUI.
